derivation: amendment A13: <template> subtrees are not scanned, so the en_US link inside the template produces nothing; the page's en self alternate and canonical self keep it clean.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<template><link rel="alternate" hreflang="en_US" href="https://alpha.example/a"></template>
</head><body></body></html>
